0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-7, 0-3 on the road, six straight losses) are 14th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, while the Minnesota Timberwolves (6-3, two straight wins) are 8th in the West and 3rd in the Northwest, 1 game back. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 the Jazz lost the series 1-3, including a 147-111 loss in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
